description: Blazor project and item templates with Telerik UI for Blazor and Docker integration. Configure the Telerik Blazor components via template options like CSS theme, icon type, localization, and RTL support.
releaseNotes:
NEW
* Use .NET 9+ static asset finger printing for the Telerik CSS and JS file in the Web App template. Classic query string cache busting remains in use in .NET 8.
* Use .NET 10+ finger printing for the Telerik JS file in the WebAssembly Standalone App template.
* Add support for Telerik UI for Blazor 11.0.0.
* Add compatibility with .NET 10 Preview 7. Older .NET 10 versions are not supported due to breaking changes.
* Use Unix line endings as in the .NET 10 project templates.

FIXED
* Fix broken anchor tag in MainLayout.razor in Blazor Web App template.
* Use correct ReconnectModal.razor.js URL in .NET 10 Web App apps with Auto render mode.
* Add Docker profile to launchSettings.json only when using Docker integration.
title: Telerik Blazor Project and Item Templates
